title: Refund policy
content: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 business days.

title: Shipping times
content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping delivers the next business day for orders placed before 2 pm.

title: Password reset
content: To reset a password, open the sign-in page, choose Forgot password, and follow the link sent to the registered email address. The link expires after 15 minutes.

title: Order cancellation
content: An order can be cancelled free of charge until it has been handed to the carrier. After that, the customer must refuse delivery or start a return.

title: Warranty coverage
content: Hardware is covered by a two-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and normal wear are not covered.

title: Loyalty points
content: Members earn one point for every dollar spent. Points can be redeemed at checkout, and they expire 12 months after the last purchase.

title: API rate limits
content: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per API key. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: Data retention
content: Order records are kept for seven years to meet tax requirements. Customers can ask for personal data to be erased, except data required by law.

title: Two-factor authentication
content: Two-factor authentication can be enabled in account settings using an authenticator app. Backup codes are shown once and should be stored safely.

title: Payment methods
content: We accept major credit cards, bank transfer, and digital wallets. Bank transfers must be received within 3 days or the order is cancelled automatically.

title: Incident response
content: Security incidents are triaged within one hour. Affected customers are notified within 72 hours when personal data is involved.

title: Service availability
content: The platform targets 99.9 percent monthly availability. Planned maintenance is announced at least 48 hours in advance.
